name: Snorkelling on the dive boat

seo.title: Snorkelling on a Dive Boat, Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Snorkel at the local reefs from the dive boat while your family or friends dive. Children under 5 come free and a nanny can stay on board. From 1,800 THB.

lead: Come along on the dive boat and snorkel at the local sites while your family or friends dive. A nanny can stay on board with the youngest.
promise: Snorkel from the dive boat while others dive
